highlights.degree: Master of Science in Technology (M.Sc. Tech)

overview: Studying Civil Engineering - PG in Finland offers Indian students access to world-renowned Nordic education, innovative practical research, English-taught programmes, and excellent European career pathways.

faq.question: Can Indian students study Civil Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes. Indian students with a recognized B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering or related fields can apply for English-taught master

faq.question: Is Civil Engineering taught in English in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes. Prestigious Finnish universities like Aalto University, Tampere University, and the University of Oulu offer 100% English-taught master

faq.question: What is the tuition fee for Civil Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Tuition fees for non-EU/EEA students range between €10,000 and €17,000 per year (approximately ₹10.5 to ₹17.85 lakh per annum). Merit-based scholarships covering 50% to 100% of tuition are widely available.

faq.question: Can international graduates work in Finland after completing Civil Engineering?
faq.answer: Yes. Finland provides an extended 2-year post-study work permit for international graduates, allowing them to work in structural engineering, construction management, infrastructure, and consultancy across Finland and the EU.
